code:
secret is 42
won is nay
guess mak num
tries is 0
tries wlt 7
  tries add 1
  guess get "Your guess? "
  guess ieq secret
    won is yes
    now ebk now
won ieq yes
  out prn "Right, in @tries tries!"
now oth now
  out prn "Out of tries! It was @secret."
output:

Your guess? 2
Your guess? 3

shop mak vec@own@Pet
d mwn Dog&"Rex"
shop add d
b mwn Bird&"Kiwi"
shop add b
p fea shop
  p wait now
  name is p@name
  sound is p@sound
  hunger is p@hunger
  out prn "@name says @sound, with hunger @hunger"

Pet dcl now
  name dfd txt
  hunger dfd 0
  Pet dmk now
    n dpm txt
    name is n
  wait dvr now
    hunger add 2
  sound dmb txt

Dog dcl Pet
  Dog dmk now
    n dpm txt
    now dbs n
  wait dov now
    hunger add 3
  sound dov txt
    sound ert "Woof"

Bird dcl Pet
  Bird dmk now
    n dpm txt
    now dbs n
  sound dov txt
    sound ert "Tweet"
